attributes.description: Alerts when a Lambda function's error rate (Errors / Invocations) over the last 15 minutes is above an absolute floor AND materially above the function's own trailing 45-minute baseline (>= 2x or +10 percentage points). Functions with no usable baseline fall back to the absolute floor. Evaluates the top 10 functions by error rate.
attributes.name: [AWS Lambda OTel] High error rate

investigation_guide.blob:
## High Error Rate

### Triage Steps
1. Identify the affected function and region from the alert context.
2. Check CloudWatch Logs for the function — look for unhandled exceptions and stack traces.
3. Correlate with recent deployments or configuration changes.
4. Review downstream dependencies (APIs, databases) that the function calls.
5. Compare error rate against the function overview dashboard for trend context.

### Escalation
If error rate persists above your SLO for more than 15 minutes, page the owning team.

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM metrics-aws.lambda.otel-*
| WHERE Namespace == "AWS/Lambda"
    AND stat == "Sum"
    AND MetricName IN ("Errors", "Invocations")
    AND FunctionName IS NOT NULL
| STATS
    incident_errors      = SUM(`metrics.amazonaws.com/AWS/Lambda/Errors`)      WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tend - 15 minutes,
    incident_invocations = SUM(`metrics.amazonaws.com/AWS/Lambda/Invocations`) WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tend - 15 minutes,
    baseline_errors      = SUM(`metrics.amazonaws.com/AWS/Lambda/Errors`)      WHERE @timestamp <  ?_tend - 15 minutes,
    baseline_invocations = SUM(`metrics.amazonaws.com/AWS/Lambda/Invocations`) WHERE @timestamp <  ?_tend - 15 minutes
  BY FunctionName, cloud.region
// Minimum invocation volume — tune for low-traffic functions
| WHERE incident_invocations > 10
| EVAL error_rate_pct = ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(incident_errors) / incident_invocations * 100.0, 2),
       baseline_error_rate_pct = CASE(baseline_invocations > 10, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(baseline_errors) / baseline_invocations * 100.0, 2), null)
// Fire when the CURRENT 15m error rate is above the absolute floor (tune to SLO) AND
// materially above THIS function's own trailing-45m baseline (>= 2x, or +10 percentage
// points). Functions without a usable baseline fall back to the floor alone. Workloads
// with a steady ambient error rate no longer alert perpetually; genuine rate jumps fire.
| WHERE error_rate_pct > 1.0
    AND (baseline_error_rate_pct IS NULL OR error_rate_pct >= 2.0 * baseline_error_rate_pct OR error_rate_pct >= baseline_error_rate_pct + 10.0)
| EVAL function_id = CONCAT(FunctionName, "/", cloud.region)
| SORT error_rate_pct DESC
| LIMIT 10
